title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.16728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. translated_title: EgoX：基于具身梦境的第一人称视角跨具身操作
translated_abstract: 通用操作策略可以从人类、真实机器人和仿真智能体的互补经验中受益。然而，三者之间在形态结构、感知方式和控制接口上的差异，使得从它们组合的演示数据中进行有效学习变得困难。我们提出了EgoX，一个第一人称视角的跨具身学习框架，通过语义上相互对应的观测模态和动作模态来组织异构演示数据。EgoX在这一混合数据上预训练一个带具身梦境的模块化跨具身Transformer（MXT+），并在目标具身的演示数据上进行微调。在每个具身体内，MXT+为每个观测模态分配一个专用的分词器，为每个动作模态分配一个专用的专家，而Transformer主干则在所有具身之间共享。一个仅在训练阶段使用的具身梦境目标函数用于预测未来视觉状态和本体感觉状态的潜在表示，从而鼓励共享主干……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EgoX提出了一种第一人称视角的跨具身学习框架，通过为每个观测和动作模态配置专用分词器与专家模块、共享Transformer主干，并借助仅在训练阶段使用的“具身梦境”未来状态预测目标，使通用操作策略能够有效利用人类、真实机器人和仿真智能体的异构演示数据。
en_tdlr: EgoX is an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that combines dedicated per-modality tokenizers and action experts with a shared Transformer trunk and a training-only "embodiment dreaming" objective, enabling generalist manipulation policies to effectively learn from heterogeneous demonstrations of humans, real robots, and simulated agents.
